reader.notes: The size check is one runtime member (FileConnector.Stored via KeyedConnector.RecordRulesFailure) asked by RelativeConnector.Rewrite before the record lookup, for every access mode, with no edition arm. Probes at --std 85 give 44 at both bounds' violations and zero, with the file record and record area unaffected. A follow-on REWRITE in sequential access after the failed one gives 43, which GR2 requires (the last I-O statement was not a successful READ).
reader.at-2023: gr12b at --std 2023 prints the same lines (S2 44, S3 44, S5 00)

refuter.evidence: Attacked the range the reader left out: RECORD IS VARYING with no FROM/TO (bounds implied from the record descriptions 01 X(6) / 01 X(15), §1985:VII.3.8.4 GR6/GR7), the FROM phrase (GR5: the MOVE happens, then the REWRITE fails), and a 44 with no INVALID KEY phrase and a USE procedure. rf12a.cob at --std 85: C1 LN 16 ST=44, C2 LN 5 ST=44, C3 LN 6 ST=00, C4 REWRITE FROM at LN 16 ST=44, reread R1 LN=0006 [SSSSSS] (C1/C2/C4 did not update); sequential file VARYING 5 TO 12, LN 13 without phrases: 'USE-U RAN ST=44' then 'U1 AFTER ST=44'. Every result is what the text requires. cite.py: 'OK  §1985:VIII.4.6.4 GR12  (4.6.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR12'; 'OK  §1985:VII.3.8.4 GR7  (3.8.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR7'; 'OK  §1985:VIII.4.6.4 GR5  (4.6.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR5'; 'OK  §1985:VIII.4.8.4 GR5  (4.8.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR5'. Without DEPENDING ON the rule cannot fire on a legal program: §1985:VII.3.8.3 SR2 keeps every record description (ODO at its min/max) inside the bounds.
